mechanism_card.hypothesis: Swapping 10% lowest-ranked for next-ranked tests pure ranking quality at fixed mass (constant S), isolating T vs FP trade-off
mechanism_card.mechanism: Constant S holds denominator 0.2(S-M) stable; DTI change = ΔT / (0.2(T+S-M)+0.8|G|); positive if replacement dots have higher expected kernel overlap with blind truth
mechanism_card.non_fault_mimic: Flight-line corrugation (400m Area2 spacing) creates periodic ranking noise; swapping may exchange real fault dots for artifact-aligned dots
mechanism_card.falsifier: If live DTI unchanged (<0.01), ranking is no better than random at this mass; if negative, next-ranked pool is farther from geothermal signal than dropped near-cat fringe
